ground_truth_jd:
About the Job
zerohash is looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead the team architecting and building our open banking data aggregation platform. This is a high-performing team tackling deeply technical, adversarial problems in browser internals and secure automation. We're looking for a true technologist with a love of programming and a drive for technical excellence. We believe the best managers are technologists first, with a product mindset, who seek to make a larger impact across the organization. You will lead the team building secure, agent-based automation infrastructure (e.g., Chrome Manifest V3 extensions, iOS WKWebViews), transforming unstructured web data into programmable APIs that bridge traditional finance and digital assets.

Responsibilities
- Research and design new methods that push the boundaries of secure web automation
- Lead a team of engineers building the core automation runtime, guiding architecture for resilient UI interactions, reliable programmatic data entry, and robust session routing.
- Partner closely with product and program managers to ensure the open banking roadmap is well understood and the team can plan and execute on expected outcomes.
- Work with the team on technical planning to ensure requirements are captured in the technical solution.
- Partner with other Engineering Managers to drive the broader technical roadmap forward.
- Support the engineering team in achieving a high level of technical excellence in browser automation, extension development, and secure data extraction.
- Manage processes to help the team do its best work.
- Recruit, coach, and develop engineers specializing in web automation, browser internals, and distributed systems.
- Help engineers establish career development plans.
- Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives.
- Participate in essential technical, design, and product discussions with leaders.
- Work with stakeholders to build a clear vision for the team's role in the open banking ecosystem.
- Oversee the success of the team's projects, driving resiliency, scalability, and coverage.
- Introduce industry-leading engineering patterns and practices.
- Make consistent development contributions.

Requirements
- 10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience focused on advanced web automation, browser internals, extension development, or complex data extraction.
- 5+ years of engineering management experience, including managing senior/staff-level engineers.
- BS or MS in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent experience.
- Proven track record managing teams delivering complex, production-grade browser automation or data infrastructure products.
- Deep proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, DOM manipulation, modern web APIs, browser execution environments.
- Strong backend experience (Golang, Node.js, or Python).
- Strong security fundamentals across trust boundaries, authentication handshakes, DOM-based injection risks.
- Experience with distributed systems, persistent connections, stateful multi-hop sessions.
- Comfort with ambiguity.

Preferred
- Shipped production-grade browser extensions (Chrome MV3) or mobile web automation (iOS WKWebView, Android WebView).
- Strong understanding of WebAuthn/Passkey protocols.
- Prior engineering leadership at a major financial data aggregator or building zero-knowledge/client-side data extraction tools.
- Understanding of cryptocurrency/blockchain technology.

Benefits
- Healthcare Insurance (~100% employee premiums, U.S. only)
- Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
- Chance to earn equity
- Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
- WeWork All Access Membership
- WFH Yearly Stipend
- L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)
